content.value: . A four pole, long shunt DC compound generator supplies 250 Vat 50A in the load. The generator has Armature, Series and shunt field resistances of 0.5.0., 0.30. and 2000., respectively. Find the following:
i) The generated emf and armature current.
ii) If total number of armature conductor is 500, and rotated in 1500 rpm what will be the flux required to generate the voltage as in (i).
